query_normalized: quantifying the impact of network proximity on epidemic spreading in scale-free networks physics
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) as it investigates the same biological mechanism (epidemic spreading) on the exact same domain (scale-free networks) and measures the relationship between network properties (node strength/weight distribution) and spreading velocity, which is a direct proxy for the user's interest in "network proximity" and its impact on spreading dynamics.
